title: Level 5 Leadership
hook: The best leaders I know are weirdly humble. They're also the most stubborn people in the room.
statement: Great leaders mix real personal humility with a fierce, unbending will to get results.
explainer: Humility without drive goes nowhere. Drive without humility pushes good people out. When your ambition is clearly for the mission and not your image, people trust you and stay.
sop: When picking leaders, weight Humility and Mission Focus heavily.
Watch how each leader handles credit and blame.
Coach the big egos, or move them aside.
Promote people whose ambition serves the company.
equation_example: Score each 1 to 10. Humility 6, Will 9, Mission Focus 8. 6 × 9 × 8 = 432 out of 1,000. Higher means your team trusts your ambition. Lower, especially on Humility, means talented people eventually stop wanting to work for you.
question: Write down the last time you took the blame publicly and handed someone else the credit.
closing_statement: Ambition should serve the mission, not the ego.
caption:
Principle Nº 278: Level 5 Leadership
